description: This Java source file defines the TbKafkaNode class, which is a rule node component for publishing messages to Kafka within the Thingsboard platform. It manages Kafka producer initialization, message publishing with optional metadata headers, and handles responses and errors.

classes.name: TbKafkaNode
classes.description: A rule node component for publishing messages to Kafka, managing Kafka producer lifecycle, message metadata, and error handling.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the Kafka producer with configuration properties, sets up error handling, and prepares the node for message processing.

methods.name: getKafkaProducer
methods.description: Creates and returns a new KafkaProducer instance with the provided properties.

methods.name: onMsg
methods.description: Handles incoming messages, processes topic and key patterns, and triggers message publishing.

methods.name: publish
methods.description: Sends a message to Kafka, optionally adding metadata as headers, and processes the send result.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Closes the Kafka producer during node shutdown.

methods.name: processRecord
methods.description: Processes the result of Kafka send, handling success or failure.

methods.name: processResponse
methods.description: Updates message metadata with Kafka record details upon successful send.

methods.name: processException
methods.description: Updates message metadata with error information upon failure.

methods.name: upgrade
methods.description: Handles configuration upgrades from older versions.
